_comment: Field names deliberately mirror the columns a future migration 036 would add
to trainer.deck, and the five vectors are ALSO accepted under their real
public.decks column names (scrycheck_speed, ...) so the same generator can be
pointed at a Supabase query with no reshaping once 035 is applied.
decklist_url is the ScryCheck analysis page — migration 035 calls that value
'THE TAP TARGET'. It is publicly viewable, stable, and unguessable, so it
carries no enumeration risk the way a sequential /deck/0042 would.
A null vector means NOT GRADED and prints an em dash, not a zero.
The final line of the deck name gets the mockup's inverted accent block.
Because the mockup sets line-height 0.94, that block overlaps the line above
it — fine at one or two lines, visibly clipping at four or more. Set
"accent": null on a deck to turn it off for that card.
